title: tecoma speciosa
intro: Tecoma speciosa, commonly known as the Yellow Bells or Esperanza, is a flowering plant species in the trumpet vine family. This plant is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma speciosa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Tecoma speciosa have been found to have potential in protecting against oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and modulating the immune system.
